reviews.feedback: internal/store/customers.go:97-100 and its caller at line 72: the email_taken check uses the global customersByEmail index, which keeps only one owner per email across all organizations. If Acme and Globex both hold jane@example.com (allowed by CreateCustomer), the index points at Globex's customer, so customerEmailTaken(acme, key) returns false and the import creates a second Acme customer with that email, violating 'email may not be used by an existing customer of the organization'. Fix: in ImportCustomers, before the loop, build a set of the organization's own normalized emails by iterating s.customers where OrgID == orgID, and use that set for the email_taken check instead of the global index. Also, line 90 overwrites another organization's index entry, so the index should not be trusted for cross-org cases at all. Add a test: Acme and Globex each create jane@example.com, then importing jane@example.com into Acme must return 422 invalid_rows with email_taken on that row.
